snippet.title: THE RUMOURS ARE TRUE...
snippet.description:
The rumours are true... another brand new venue is coming to Burton!

Nathan also gives us a quick Isabel's update... loads of new staff now in, more still to come, and a much bigger management team in place. He announces some exciting events as well... what a crazy 8 weeks it's been. Burton is on the up!

snippet.title: EPISODE 16: MONTH 1 COMPLETED!!
snippet.description: Month one done! its been an incredible first four weeks, and in todays vlog Nathan's walking you through the changes we've already made from your feedback (and what we're improving next). As Gordon Ramsay says, "65% of new restaurants fail in the first 12 months - you can't be just good anymore, you have to be great"... and we can only stay great with your honest, constructive feedback. Hit play for the full update, the wins, the lessons, and what's coming next for Isabel's...

snippet.title: EPISODE 15: OUR FIRST SATURDAY!!
snippet.description:
Wow… what a first weekend!!
Nathan’s taking you behind the scenes to show the madness and how Isabel’s goes from a calm, family-friendly restaurant in the day… to basically a full-on nightclub vibe on a Friday/Saturday night 💃🕺
That’s always been the vision: something for everyone, all under one roof.
And we genuinely want to get this right… so we’re asking for honest feedback.

 Watch ‘til the end and tell us what you think.

snippet.title: EPISODE 14: WE ARE OPEN!!
snippet.description: Isabel's Restaurant is officially open.... and wow, the first few days have been absolutely mental. From packed services to unexpected moments behind the scenes, its been a wild start, Nathan gives you an update on how opening week has gone, the highs, the stress, the surprises and what its actually like after the doors have finally opened.

snippet.title: EPISODE 13: ISABEL'S IS READY!!
snippet.description:
Isabel’s is ready! Take a look...

What a few months it has been… we’re honestly lost for words. Thank you so much for the love, the messages, and the support.

Built for Burton. Something for everyone.

snippet.title: EPISODE 12: WE ARE ALMOST READY!!
snippet.description:
Big changes since the last episode...

Nathan takes us back inside Isabel's to show just how much has come together since we last checked in. From the space itself to the finer details the transformation is real an we can see thew vision coming to life, with every update Isabel's is getting closer opening its doors and this episode shows just how far its come.,

snippet.title: EPISODE 11: YOU CRASHED OUR WEBSITE!!
snippet.description:
2000 Bookings in 24 hours...We honestly didn't see this coming, in just 24 hours, over 2000 bookings came through and the demand was so intense that it crashed our website!

Huge update on the building which is now nearly ready and entering the final stages before opening. If you've been following the journey, this is a massive milestone. if you're new here, welcome... you're seeing this at a wild moment.

snippet.title: EPISODE 10: THE ORIGINAL ISABEL'S HAS CLOSED DOWN!!
snippet.description: Today we say goodbye to the original Isabel's. In this video Nathans family share some words, memories and emotions as Isabel's original location comes to a close.

snippet.title: EPISODE 9: WE HAVE A PRIVATE DINING ROOM!!
snippet.description: Our private dining room is perfect for intimate celebrations, special occasions, and exclusive events, Isabel's private dining room offers a stylish luxurious setting paired with exceptional food, signature cocktails, and an unforgettable atmosphere.

snippet.title: EPISODE 8: OUR SIGNAGE IS UP!!
snippet.description: The signage is up! A huge moment for Isabel's Restaurant & Bar making it feel more official and more real, this is the start of a brand-new chapter. we can't wait to welcome you in.

snippet.title: EPISODE 7: WE FINALLY HAVE BIGGER TOILETS...
snippet.description: The toilets are finally bigger, we've upgraded BIG time. If you remember queuing for the old ones, one in one out... yeah, those days are GONE! Bigger toilets, better vibes and the glow up continues!

snippet.title: EPISODE 6: WALL'S ARE BEING KNOCKED DOWN!!
snippet.description: We've officially started knocking down the walls to create an even bigger and better Isabel's, From new layouts to a fresh vision for the future, the transformation is just the beginning.

snippet.title: EPISODE 5: OUR TILES HAVE ARRIVED!
snippet.description: Our brand new tiles have arrived and we're giving you a sneak peek behind the scenes as we take Isabel's to the next level. From the moment you walk through the door we want you to feel the vibe, the energy, and the passion that goes into every detail of our space.

snippet.title: EPISODE 4: LET THE BUILDING COMMENCE...
snippet.description: This marks a huge milestone in the journey of Isabel's. Building has officially commenced after months of planning and preparation the vision is now taking physical shape.

snippet.title: EPISODE 3: ANNOUNCING THE NEW ISABEL'S AT THE BURTON CHRISTMAS LIGHTS!
snippet.description:
We are excited to officially announce Isabel's, Nathan Dawe's brand-new Restaurant & Bar revealed at the Burton Christmas lights switch on!

Set against the magic of the festive season this special moment marks the first public reveal of Isabel's, a brand new space bringing great food, drinks, music and atmosphere right tho the heart of Burton.

snippet.title: EPISODE 2: AND THE PLANNING BEGINS...
snippet.description: This video is the very beginning of Isabel's where the planning starts now, from early ideas and inspirations to the challenges, decisions, and the creative process behind the building.

snippet.title: EPISODE 1: ISABEL'S BURTON IS MOVING!!
snippet.description:
A NEW CHAPTER FOR ISABEL'S!

Big news! Isabel's Restaurant & Bar is officially on the move. Join Nathan Dawe as he takes you behind the scenes of an exciting new chapter... from saying goodbye to our original home to welcoming you into a brand-new space.

en.description: The toilets are finally bigger, we've upgraded BIG time. If you remember queuing for the old ones, one in one out... yeah, those days are GONE! Bigger toilets, better vibes and the glow up continues!

pt-BR.title: EPISÓDIO 7: FINALMENTE TEMOS BANHEIROS MAIORES...
pt-BR.description: Os banheiros finalmente estão maiores, fizemos uma reforma ENORME. Se você se lembra das filas para os antigos, onde só uma pessoa entrava e saía... é, esses dias ACABARAM! Banheiros maiores, ambiente melhor e a transformação continua!

hi.title: एपिसोड 7: आखिरकार हमारे पास बड़े शौचालय हैं...
hi.description: आखिरकार शौचालय बड़े हो गए हैं, हमने ज़बरदस्त सुधार किया है। अगर आपको पुराने शौचालयों के लिए लंबी कतारें याद हों, जिनमें एक-एक करके लोग अंदर जाते थे... तो अब वो दिन गए! बड़े शौचालय, बेहतर माहौल और बदलाव जारी है!

fr-FR.title: ÉPISODE 7 : NOUS AVONS ENFIN DES TOILETTES PLUS GRANDES...
fr-FR.description: Les toilettes sont enfin plus spacieuses ! On a fait une sacrée mise à jour. Si vous vous souvenez des files d'attente interminables aux anciennes toilettes (un qui entrait, un qui sortait…), eh bien, c'est du passé ! Toilettes plus grandes, ambiance améliorée et la transformation continue !

es-US.title: EPISODIO 7: FINALMENTE TENEMOS BAÑOS MÁS GRANDES...
es-US.description: Los baños por fin son más grandes; los hemos mejorado muchísimo. Si recuerdas la fila para los antiguos, uno entra, uno sale... ¡sí, esos días se acabaron! Baños más grandes, mejor ambiente y ¡la renovación continúa!

de-DE.title: FOLGE 7: ENDLICH HABEN WIR GRÖSSERE TOILETTEN...
de-DE.description: Die Toiletten sind endlich größer, wir haben richtig aufgerüstet! Wer sich noch an die alten Toiletten erinnert, wo man nur einzeln rein und wieder raus durfte … ja, diese Zeiten sind vorbei! Größere Toiletten, bessere Atmosphäre und die Modernisierung geht weiter!

id.title: EPISODE 7: AKHIRNYA KAMI PUNYA TOILET YANG LEBIH BESAR...
id.description: Toiletnya akhirnya lebih besar, kami telah melakukan peningkatan BESAR-BESARAN. Jika Anda ingat antrean di toilet lama, satu masuk satu keluar... ya, masa-masa itu sudah BERAKHIR! Toilet lebih besar, suasana lebih baik, dan peningkatan terus berlanjut!

it.title: EPISODIO 7: FINALMENTE ABBIAMO DEI BAGNI PIÙ GRANDI...
it.description: I bagni sono finalmente più grandi, li abbiamo migliorati alla grande. Se vi ricordate le code per i vecchi bagni, uno dentro e uno fuori... sì, quei tempi sono FINITI! Bagni più grandi, atmosfera migliore e il benessere continua!

snippet.title: EPISODE 6: WALL'S ARE BEING KNOCKED DOWN!!
snippet.description: We've officially started knocking down the walls to create an even bigger and better Isabel's, From new layouts to a fresh vision for the future, the transformation is just the beginning.

localized.title: EPISODE 6: WALL'S ARE BEING KNOCKED DOWN!!
localized.description: We've officially started knocking down the walls to create an even bigger and better Isabel's, From new layouts to a fresh vision for the future, the transformation is just the beginning.

es-US.title: EPISODIO 6: ¡¡¡ESTÁN DERRIBANDO MUROS!!!
es-US.description: Hemos comenzado oficialmente a derribar las paredes para crear un Isabel's aún más grande y mejor. Desde nuevos diseños hasta una nueva visión para el futuro, la transformación es solo el comienzo.

fr-FR.title: ÉPISODE 6 : LES MURS SONT ABAISSÉS !!
fr-FR.description: Nous avons officiellement commencé à abattre les murs pour créer un Isabel's encore plus grand et plus performant. De nouveaux aménagements à une vision renouvelée de l'avenir, la transformation n'est que le début.

hi.title: एपिसोड 6: दीवारें गिराई जा रही हैं!!
hi.description: हमने आधिकारिक तौर पर दीवारों को गिराना शुरू कर दिया है ताकि इसाबेल का और भी बड़ा और बेहतर संस्करण बनाया जा सके। नए लेआउट से लेकर भविष्य के लिए एक नए दृष्टिकोण तक, यह परिवर्तन तो बस शुरुआत है।

pt-BR.title: EPISÓDIO 6: PAREDES ESTÃO SENDO DERRUBADAS!!
pt-BR.description: Oficialmente, começamos a derrubar as paredes para criar um Isabel's ainda maior e melhor. De novos layouts a uma visão inovadora para o futuro, a transformação é apenas o começo.

en.title: EPISODE 6: WALL'S ARE BEING KNOCKED DOWN!!
en.description: We've officially started knocking down the walls to create an even bigger and better Isabel's, From new layouts to a fresh vision for the future, the transformation is just the beginning.

de-DE.title: FOLGE 6: MAUERN WERDEN EINGEBRACHT!!
de-DE.description: Wir haben offiziell damit begonnen, die Wände einzureißen, um ein noch größeres und besseres Isabel's zu schaffen. Von neuen Raumaufteilungen bis hin zu einer frischen Zukunftsvision ist die Transformation erst der Anfang.

it.title: EPISODIO 6: I MURI VENGONO ABBATTUTI!!
it.description: Abbiamo ufficialmente iniziato ad abbattere i muri per creare un Isabel's ancora più grande e migliore. Dai nuovi layout a una nuova visione per il futuro, la trasformazione è solo l'inizio.

id.title: EPISODE 6: TEMBOK-TEMBOK SEDANG DIRUNTUHKAN!!
id.description: Kami secara resmi telah mulai merobohkan tembok untuk menciptakan Isabel's yang lebih besar dan lebih baik lagi. Mulai dari tata letak baru hingga visi segar untuk masa depan, transformasi ini hanyalah permulaan.

snippet.title: EPISODE 5: OUR TILES HAVE ARRIVED!
snippet.description: Our brand new tiles have arrived and we're giving you a sneak peek behind the scenes as we take Isabel's to the next level. From the moment you walk through the door we want you to feel the vibe, the energy, and the passion that goes into every detail of our space.

localized.title: EPISODE 5: OUR TILES HAVE ARRIVED!
localized.description: Our brand new tiles have arrived and we're giving you a sneak peek behind the scenes as we take Isabel's to the next level. From the moment you walk through the door we want you to feel the vibe, the energy, and the passion that goes into every detail of our space.

id.title: EPISODE 5: UBIN KAMI TELAH TIBA!
id.description: Ubin baru kami telah tiba dan kami memberikan Anda sedikit bocoran di balik layar saat kami membawa Isabel's ke level berikutnya. Sejak Anda melangkah masuk, kami ingin Anda merasakan getaran, energi, dan semangat yang dituangkan ke dalam setiap detail ruangan kami.

it.title: EPISODIO 5: LE NOSTRE PIASTRELLE SONO ARRIVATE!
it.description: Le nostre nuovissime piastrelle sono arrivate e vi offriamo un'anteprima dietro le quinte, mentre portiamo Isabel's a un livello superiore. Dal momento in cui varcate la soglia, vogliamo che percepiate l'atmosfera, l'energia e la passione che permeano ogni dettaglio del nostro spazio.

hi.title: एपिसोड 5: हमारी टाइलें आ गई हैं!
hi.description: हमारी बिल्कुल नई टाइलें आ गई हैं और हम आपको इसाबेल के नवीनीकरण की एक झलक दिखा रहे हैं। जैसे ही आप हमारे यहाँ कदम रखेंगे, हम चाहते हैं कि आप हमारे स्थान की हर बारीकी में समाई हुई ऊर्जा, उत्साह और जुनून को महसूस करें।

pt-BR.title: EPISÓDIO 5: NOSSOS AZULEJOS CHEGARAM!
pt-BR.description: Nossos azulejos novinhos em folha chegaram e estamos dando a vocês uma espiadinha nos bastidores enquanto elevamos o Isabel's a um novo patamar. Queremos que, desde o momento em que você entra pela porta, sinta a vibração, a energia e a paixão que dedicamos a cada detalhe do nosso espaço.

en.title: EPISODE 5: OUR TILES HAVE ARRIVED!
en.description: Our brand new tiles have arrived and we're giving you a sneak peek behind the scenes as we take Isabel's to the next level. From the moment you walk through the door we want you to feel the vibe, the energy, and the passion that goes into every detail of our space.

fr-FR.title: ÉPISODE 5 : NOS CARRELAGES SONT ARRIVÉS !
fr-FR.description: Nos nouveaux carreaux sont arrivés et nous vous offrons un aperçu des coulisses de la transformation d'Isabel's. Dès votre arrivée, nous voulons que vous ressentiez l'ambiance, l'énergie et la passion qui animent chaque détail de notre espace.

es-US.title: EPISODIO 5: ¡NUESTROS AZULEJOS HAN LLEGADO!
es-US.description: Ya llegaron nuestros nuevos azulejos y te mostramos un adelanto tras bambalinas mientras llevamos a Isabel's al siguiente nivel. Desde el momento en que cruzas la puerta, queremos que sientas la vibra, la energía y la pasión que se refleja en cada detalle de nuestro espacio.

snippet.title: ISABEL'S ZAKYNTHOS - THE FINALE
snippet.description: What a journey it's been! from the building stage to staff training, food, drink and wine tastings, crafting our menu's, and shaping the perfect vibe, every step has led us here. We're now open, and it's incredible to see Isabel's packed and buzzing every single night. thank you all for your amazing support, Isabel's is officially open! exciting things are ahead, and I can't wait to see what next summer brings. So... where to next?
